meta.title: Optimize group by algorithm
meta.body_summary: Add needItems tracking to VM compiler to omit storing group items when unused; conditionally accumulate group items only when required.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, added needItems tracking in the compiler to conditionally generate code for storing group items; added helper functions in queryutil.go to detect aggregate usage. When items are not needed, they are not accumulated, reducing memory overhead.
change_trajectory: Single commit 'optimize group by aggregation' modified both files; 252 additions in queryutil.go (new helper detection) and 28 additions/13 deletions in vm.go (tracking logic).
